title: </sub>  Exclude pre-review skips from the sweep criterion
text:
</sub>  Exclude pre-review skips from the sweep criterion

When an enabled trigger targets a draft PR or an automatic run finds an existing check, the current flow returns before reading changed files or invoking the model (`src/core/run-review-pass.ts:141-176`), while AC2 explicitly preserves draft-skip behavior. AC1 nevertheless requires every review pass to consider every category and emit a per-category log record, making the acceptance criteria incompatible for those inputs. Scope AC1 to passes that reach review execution and state whether early skips emit any sweep metadata.
